_doc: Verified text corrections applied by scripts/parse_act_v2.py AFTER clause location. Each entry must match the parsed clause text EXACTLY ONCE or the parse fails. Each entry carries its evidence and must be signed in verified_by by a human who read the gazette scan. Scope: (1) text the OCR invented or lost (show-through, garbled words); (2) OCR errors inside a LEGAL AMOUNT a user could misread (user decision 2026-10-15). NOT for joined words or section numbering: CLAUDE.md forbids cleaning those up, so each find/replace touches only the corrupted span and leaves joins as they are.

corrections.find: on the o uuu Aun u uons o uosd Xue q aqes s go puno circumstance.
corrections.replace: on the ground of his disability by any person or institution in any manner or circumstance.
corrections.cause: Show-through: the reverse page's print shows through the paper on this scan, and the OCR read the mirrored text in place of the second line of 1(1).
corrections.evidence: data/raw/disability_act_2018_gazette_FGP.pdf, PDF page 5 (printed A101), clause 1(1), lines 1-3. v1's web transcription (data/processed/disability_act_2018_full.txt:88) independently reads 'on the ground of his disability'.
corrections.transcribed_by: Claude Code, 2026-10-15, from a 150-dpi render of PDF page 5
corrections.verified_by: Jerry, 2026-10-15, against the gazette scan PDF p.5 (A101)

corrections.cause: OCR read the middle zero of a fine amount as the letter o. Legal amount, so it is corrected (user decision 2026-10-15). The surrounding joined words are left as they are.
corrections.evidence: data/raw/disability_act_2018_gazette_FGP.pdf, PDF page 7 (printed A103), clause 12(3), last line: 'a fine of N1, 000 for each day of default'.
corrections.transcribed_by: Claude Code, 2026-10-15, from a 220-dpi render of the lower half of PDF page 7
corrections.verified_by: Jerry, 2026-10-15, against the gazette scan PDF p.7 (A103)

corrections.cause: OCR garbled 'is delivered' into 'selivere', which drops the verb of the clause's only sentence. The surrounding joined words are left as they are.
corrections.evidence: data/raw/disability_act_2018_gazette_FGP.pdf, PDF page 9 (printed A105), clause 20, line 2: '...with multiple disabilities, is delivered in the most appropriate language...'.
corrections.transcribed_by: Claude Code, 2026-10-15, from a 150-dpi render of PDF page 9
corrections.verified_by: Jerry, 2026-10-15, against the gazette scan PDF p.9 (A105)
